title: Runeblood: Origin
description: A massive Origins add-on that introduces 13 highly detailed fantasy races, such as Dragonkin and Aetherborn, each with unique magic, custom abilities, and balanced weaknesses.
body:
# ⚔️ Runeblood: Origins
Runeblood: Origins is a massive, highly detailed expansion for the Origins mod that introduces 13 brand new, mythology-inspired fantasy races to your Minecraft world.

Designed with a heavy focus on deep lore, balanced gameplay, and unique combat mechanics, this datapack/resource pack transforms how you play. Each race comes with its own set of powerful active abilities, passive traits, and severe weaknesses that force you to adapt your playstyle.

## ✨ **Features**

13 Unique Races: Play as everything from the sky-dwelling Aetherborn to the gold-obsessed Goblins.
Balanced Gameplay: Every origin has been carefully tuned. Incredible powers are offset by crippling weaknesses (e.g., Infernals die in water, Voidborn burn in sunlight).
Deep Lore: Every race is rooted in real-world mythology and fantasy literature, complete with rich in-game descriptions.
Bilingual Support: Fully translated into English (US) and Spanish (Spain).

## 🧬 **The Origins**

Here is a glimpse of the bloodlines you can choose from:

🦅 Aetherborn (Sylphs): Born of the wind. You have absolute freedom of flight and immunity to fall damage, but stepping on the earth corrupts your form and makes you incredibly fragile.

🐉 Dragonkin: Descendants of Tiamat. You can breathe fire and possess impenetrable scales, but your draconic biology demands a strict carnivore diet and water burns you from the inside out.

🌑 Voidborn: Creatures of the space between worlds. You can teleport and resist negative effects, but the light of the sun slowly destroys you.

🔥 Infernal (Ifrit): Forged from smokeless fire. You are completely immune to lava and can set enemies ablaze with your touch, but water is your ultimate doom.

⛰️ Stoneborn (Dvergar): Dwarves of living stone. You are immovable and highly resistant to explosions, but your heavy body makes you much slower than creatures of flesh.

🐻 Owlbear: Colossal beasts of the forest. You possess devastating brute strength and can cause seismic shockwaves by falling, but your sheer size makes you clumsy.

🌩️ Stormcaller: Messengers of the thunder gods. You move like lightning and summon thunder upon killing your enemies, but water short-circuits your powers.

🌲 Druidic: Masters of nature. You can photosynthesize in sunlight and heal allies using your own hunger, but the Nether destroys your connection to life.

🧝 High Elf: Children of light. You have magical precision and passive healing, but absolute darkness brings you to your knees.

🗡️ Dark Elf: Masters of stealth. You can turn completely invisible (armor included) and deal massive stealth damage, but direct sunlight burns your skin.

🌗 Half-Elf: A cursed duality. You possess moderate elven grace and can activate a hybrid frenzy, but you are eternally incomplete and slightly more fragile than pure races.

💰 Goblin: Mischievous and greedy. You are incredibly fast, passively lucky, and mine faster, but you are very small and possess less maximum health.

🛡️ Einherjar (Human Plus): Chosen of Valhalla. Your warrior body regenerates when sleeping and gains absorption near death, but your godly metabolism requires constant food.

## ⚙️ **Requirements & Installation**
Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
Required Mod: Origins (Forge)
Installation: Drop the downloaded file into your world's datapacks folder AND your game's resourcepacks folder. (If you are building a Modpack, you can use mods like Paxi or OpenLoader to load it globally).
